name: Real Eco-Energy Limited
about: Real Eco-Energy Limited engages in trading business in India. It operates in four segments: Real Estate, Media News Tv Channel, Diesel, and Trading. The company sells round bars. It is also involved in the business of construction, news broadcasting and digital marketing, and bio diesel mineral. The company was formerly known as Real News & Views Limited and changed its name to Real Eco-Energy Limited in January 2019. Real Eco-Energy Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
